description: This 3D model depicts a stylized staircase that ascends within a concrete tower structure. The tower is topped with a lighter-colored, curved platform, upon which rests another, larger concrete block. The staircase itself features white railings and wooden steps, creating a contrast between the industrial feel of the concrete and the natural warmth of the wood. The entire structure is placed on a light wood-like floor. The design is abstract and minimalist, focusing on geometric shapes and contrasting textures.
